description: Schema constants (SPEC 5.1): a field declared with an enum may be compared with its declared values.

cases.name: comparing a declared field with one of its values may guard a change
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= (get o status) "open") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)) (stop "SO-7 is" (get o status)))))

cases.name: the constant may come first
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= "open" (get o status)) (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: != works the same way
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (!= (get o status) "shipped") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: constants are folded like texts: OPEN = open
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= (get o status) "OPEN") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: the field may pass through let
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7")) (s (get o status))) (if (= s "open") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: number constants
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= (get o priority) 3) (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: a value that is not declared is still invented
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= (get o status) "closed") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: a field without declared values gives no constants
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (= (get o customer) "open") (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: ordering is not a schema constant: < with a declared value
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((o (erp.get_order id "SO-7"))) (if (< (get o priority) 3) (erp.cancel_order order (get o id)))))

cases.name: a declared value written as an argument of a change is still invented
a constant compared with another constant is not a schema constant
